title: God's Rules Quiz
description: Let's see what you learned about following God's rules!

questions.question: Why do we have rules?
options: To keep us safe and happy
questions.explanation: Rules keep us safe and happy! God gave us rules because He loves us (Colossians 3:20).

questions.question: What does it mean to be kind?
options: Being nice and loving to people
questions.explanation: Being kind means being nice and loving to other people, just like Jesus! (Ephesians 4:32).

questions.question: What did the little boy share with Jesus?
questions.explanation: The little boy shared his lunch of fish and bread, and Jesus used it to feed thousands of people!

questions.question: Does God want us to tell the truth?
questions.explanation: Yes! God wants us to always tell the truth. The Lord delights in truthful people (Proverbs 12:22).

questions.question: How can we be helpers?
options: By picking up toys and being kind
questions.explanation: We can be helpers by picking up toys, being kind, and helping others. When we help, we are being like Jesus! (Galatians 6:2).
